name: get_active_contracts
description: Active supplier contracts, optionally for one supplier

params.supplier: supplier name, or null for all suppliers

sql: SELECT contract_id, supplier, status, start_date, end_date FROM contracts WHERE status = 'active' AND (%(supplier)s::text IS NULL OR supplier ILIKE '%%' || %(supplier)s || '%%') ORDER BY contract_id LIMIT 200

name: get_maintenance_schedule
description: The maintenance schedule for one asset
sql: SELECT asset_id, name, site, maintenance_schedule FROM assets WHERE asset_id = %(asset_id)s

name: get_procurement_spend
description: Procurement spend by category for one quarter
sql: SELECT quarter, category, amount_eur FROM procurement_spend WHERE quarter = %(quarter)s ORDER BY amount_eur DESC
